entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns', 'Technical Support', or 'Sales'.
Returns.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I... I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed, it wasn't what I hoped.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88015. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I was really hoping this would work out. I feel awful about this.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor was delivered on December 15th. That was 23 days ago.
Oh, I know. It looks bad. But I swear, I tried to return it way earlier. I really needed this money back for some bills. I tried on Christmas Eve, I think it was my 9th day with it.
I understand. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference issue?

It's just a preference, but the real problem was your website. When I tried to start the return, there was a huge website error. Your whole return system was down and I couldn't print the label. I tried for hours.
I see. You're saying our system was preventing you from making the return on that day?
Yes, exactly! I even took a screenshot because I was worried this would happen. I just gave up because it was a holiday. I feel so stuck.

I am so sorry you had that experience. Let me check our internal logs for December 24th... Yes, I'm seeing it right here. We had a major server outage that day. It specifically mentions the return portal was affected. That must have been incredibly frustrating.
Okay, let me just double-check the return policy on the VeloBand Pulse... one moment... Alright. It looks like all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Wait, 90 days? Really? Oh, thank goodness.
Yes. Since you only received it 23 days ago, you are well within the window. That website issue is our fault, but you would have been covered anyway. I can process this return for you right now.
Wow. That is such a relief. Charlie, thank you so much. You have no idea how much I appreciate this.

It's my pleasure. I've just sent a new return authorization and shipping label to the email on file. You'll get a full refund once our warehouse receives the item. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
